borrower_ledger.note: per chain and pledged token, from the Morpho replays: units pledged at that chain's snapshot block, the units behind positions abandoned by the end of the window, how much of those units was already pledged at the snapshot, and the borrowers' forfeited over-collateralization (collateral at the oracle's par value, less the recovery and less the depositors' principal shortfall on the same positions, floored at zero per position). The two variants credit the recovery to principal alone (par_minus_principal) and restrict the equity to the units pledged at the snapshot (snapshot_units). The *_self_created fields and self_created_by_address are the part of the abandoned units and equity that belongs to the case's creator addresses (config/created_units.json, hit rules R17), unscaled; s7_partition dedup applies each group's free share and leaves them out.

excluded_totals.note: markets of the surface whose family token matched by symbol only; not part of this case (hit rules R9)

legacy_reconciliation.note: mainnet-Morpho scoped; cash-flow lower bound = wstUSR/USDC sum(borrow) - sum(repay) over the market's life (legacy b2 findings)

loan_side_basis.valued_at: recovery price at the valuation block

window.snapshot_rule: hit rules section 5: t0 - 24h, per chain
